proposal.description: fault_LED's blink half-period is overridden with the full 250 ms period of the intended 4 Hz blink, so the period is mistaken for the half-period.
proposal.reason: While strikes are outstanding and no latch is set, Red_LED1 toggles every 250 ms (a 2 Hz blink) instead of every 125 ms. A board recovering through its roughly 1 s clean-run window then shows only two blink cycles.

proposal.description: The FAULT_FLAGS current-protection status bit is masked while the modulator PWM is high, on the idea that the valley comparator only means something during low-side conduction.
proposal.reason: A host read of FAULT_FLAGS shows the CP bit clear whenever the synchronised Osc_in is high, even though CP_trig is asserted. With the modulator held high, or a read landing in the on-time, a live overcurrent comparator is not reported.

proposal.description: reg_file's UVLO status bit is masked outside S_SS and S_RUN, copying fault_cause's 'a routine power-down asserts UVLO' capture rule into the live status register.
proposal.reason: In S_OFF with the debounced UVLO asserted (for example after reset with the input rail low), FAULT_FLAGS reads UVLO clear even though UVLO is what holds the supervisor off. The host cannot see why the converter will not start.

proposal.description: strike_counter's clean-run streak is also broken whenever the output comparator reports the rail out of window, so 'fault-free running' is taken to need the rail in regulation as well as no overcurrent window trip.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with PGOOD_comp low, or dipping now and then, the clean-run counter keeps restarting. strike_level then never clears after clean_run_target cycles: STRIKE_LEVEL stays non-zero, Red_LED1 keeps blinking and the next hiccup cool-down is longer than it should be.
